response.what_it_is: Assorted used electric pressing irons displayed in a pile
hidden_risks: Heating element may be burnt out or faulty
Power cord may be frayed, cut, or unsafe
Thermostat may fail to regulate temperature
Internal water tank or steam vents may be blocked with limescale
response.best_proof: A close-up photograph of the specific iron being purchased, showing its soleplate condition and tested working status.
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the pile photo to mean the entire lot of irons is sold for 30,000 NGN instead of a single unit, or failing to realize the specific iron delivered may be a lower-quality one from the pile.
